maya: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a tiny docs PR to add a SELinux + cgroup v2 troubleshooting note for the private installer. Will include: a minimal systemd socket drop-in, a /etc/tmpfiles.d snippet, and a short Podman rootless hint. Tagging @vik for unit/tmpfiles and @alex for HSM PKCS#11 perms.

vik: On it. Draft systemd drop-in and tmpfiles below, keep it minimal so it fits the troubleshooting page. Recommend dedicated user/group `redwoodsvc`/`redwoodhsm`.

vik: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.socket.d/10-selinux.conf
[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/redwood/kms.sock
Service=redwood-kms.service
```

vik: ```conf
# /etc/tmpfiles.d/redwood.conf
# ensure runtime dir on boot
d /var/run/redwood 0750 root redwoodhsm -
```

alex: HSM note: common airgap failure is incorrect ownership on /var/lib/redwood/hsm or the PKCS11 socket. Add manual fixes and a semanage fallback line (install policycoreutils if missing). Example: `sudo chown -R root:redwoodhsm /var/lib/redwood/hsm && sudo chmod 0750 /var/lib/redwood/hsm` and `sudo semanage fcontext -a -t container_var_run_t '/var/run/redwood(/.*)?' || echo "install policycoreutils"` then `restorecon -R /var/run/redwood`.

secops-bot: Security checklist: restrict PKCS11 socket directory to group redwoodhsm, avoid symlinks, verify installer bundle checksums in airgapped flows, and prefer cgroup v2 for predictable resource limits. Document distro package names for semanage fallbacks.

docs-bot: CI started for branch maya/selinux-cgroup-hsm-note. Preview: https://docs-internal.redwood.ai/preview/4722 (expires in 24h).

maya: Pushed PR and linked above. Will keep the section concise (4 bullets + 2 snippets). Merge after secops review. Thanks!
